The '''Orn Kios system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Yarith sector/Legends|Yarith sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Orn Kios/Legends|Orn Kios]].
